snippet.title: Click Clock | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Click Clock is a 3d incremental game with mystery and atmosphere. Gain time by clicking the clock, and upgrade with blood. Explore the many talents, and keep an eye on the monster.

🎮 Demo out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5296820/Click_Clock_Demo/







#indiegame #steam #gaming
